modules.description: the app's organizing units. Every entity and every operation belongs to exactly one, and these are what the root of describe lists (A2APP-SPEC 3.1). Declared before anything that belongs to one; growth means adding and splitting modules, never lengthening a flat list.

name.description: never one of the reserved first path segments of the operate CLI (framework section 5.1): data, identity, whoami, context, tasks, events

summary.description: one line, shown on the root screen

entities.description: which entities belong to this module, for stacks whose backend schema cannot carry a per-entity module (e.g. PocketBase collections). Where the app's own schema declares the module on each entity, this is omitted and the schema is authoritative. The describe output is identical either way; only the place the fact is written differs.

capabilities.description: declared agent capabilities this app may request (framework section 7 / A2APP-SPEC 6.6)

port.description: the app's launch port: the app binds it (an env override such as PORT may take precedence) and every operate command reaches the app there (framework section 5.5)

env.description: non-normative safe-evolve marker stamped by `agent-app dev` (framework section 7.2)
